title: FileCoinGPT
tagline: This is a chat bot gpt paradigm. I am using a new UX pattern ChatDex for (chat driven experince) to interact with the Filecoin ecosystem.
description: The project presents how you can combine a chat experience with tradition UI interaction (buttons, input fields, details). The application gives the user the opportunity to request for the desired features through a chatbox. The chatbox generates the needed interaction on the right panel of the application. The application exposes the following features: Interact with Filecoin smart contract actors (request proposal info, make proposal info) , upload a CAR file, fetches file detaisl, reproduce IPFS video media and resolves ENS names,
how_its_made: This project was built using Next.js for our front end. I used ChatGPT Api chat/text completions. An express server was required to upload our CAR files to the data depot. Used Saturn for file retrieval. Interacted with the FEVM on localnet and Calibration network. Included ENS resolver profile examples to  my chatgpt endpoint. I created a new UI experience called ChatDex (Chat driven experience) which is driving the UI experience through a series of chat requests.
